newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shandong Shengli set for interim dividend.
newsitem.headline: Shandong Shengli set for interim dividend.

text.p: Shandong Shengli Co Ltd said on Tuesday it is set to make a three-for-10 scrip payout as proposed in its 1996 interim dividend plan after approval from shareholders and the Shandong Securities Management Office.

The company said in a notice published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times that the deadline for registering for the dividend was set for October 10 and its class A shares would go ex-dividend the following day.
The bonus shares will be listed on October 15.
The company earlier said its audited net profits surged 377 percent to 15.01 million yuan in the first half of 1996 from 3.15 million yuan a year earlier.
Under Chinese accounting standards, its main operating income soared 86.7 percent to 206.90 million yuan from 110.83 million yuan.
Shengli, which is involved in the production of plastic pipes used in oil fields, attributed the earnings advance to efforts to expand sales and the scale of its operations.
Shengli said it was forecasting net earnings of 24.80 million yuan for this year, up from 15.98 million yuan in 1995.
